question.text: Category III AIFs offering a 'Direct Plan' to investors must ensure that:

answer.text: Direct plans carry higher management fees to compensate for no distributor
Direct plans carry no distribution fee or placement fee
Direct plans are available only for LVFs
Direct plans cannot be offered; only distributor channels are permitted

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular dated April 10, 2023, Direct Plans of Cat III AIFs must have NO distribution fee or placement fee. The Trap: Management fees don't differ by plan in most cases; direct plans are available for all Cat III schemes. Cross-Exam Context: Mirrors the MF Direct Plan concept from Series V-A; AIF version is stricter because of HNI client base. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Investors approached through a SEBI-registered intermediary charging separate fees must be onboarded via Direct Plan only.
